text: ２たい　２で　うみの　しょうぶ　しましょ！

structure.jp: うみの　しょうぶ　しましょ！

patterns.name: 〜ましょう
patterns.explanation: ましょう on a verb means 'let's do it'; here it is clipped to ましょ in casual speech. しましょ = 'let's do it'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells in what way the battle is held. ２たい　２で = 'as two against two'.
